diagnosis.current_dynamic_acquisition: OpenAlex + Crossref metadata/abstract discovery, one generated query per Exact25 strategy, plus frozen/static evidence and verified hypothesis-only community sources.
diagnosis.known_limitation: A large result count from two metadata APIs is not equivalent to broad independent evidence synthesis. Provider diversity, mechanism extraction, contradictory evidence, prior-attempt history and source granularity must be separately gated.

required_process: curated primary/high-value corpus before candidate generation
dynamic discovery as expansion, not authority
mechanism + limitation extraction for each curated source
anti-overfit/selection-bias evidence included in every research cycle
previous terminal/no-effect attempts checked before new replay
native data granularity checked against causal claim
two independent reviewer PASS and zero explicit REJECT before replay
fresh A1 -> A2 -> A3 gate order preserved

dynamic_discovery_next_upgrade.goal: Add independent discovery channels beyond OpenAlex/Crossref without making provider count itself a quality metric.
dynamic_discovery_next_upgrade.rule: Do not expand API count before duplicate, lineage and source-quality guards are stable; otherwise more search only creates more multiple-testing noise.
